subject.title: fix: generated image previews return unauthorized

question: Should session-bound managed-image bytes returned by artifacts.download require operator.admin, or is operator.read sufficient after transcript and session validation?
rationale: Both choices are plausible security policies, and source inspection cannot determine the intended trust boundary for authenticated read-only Gateway clients.

options.title: Keep admin-only bytes
options.body: Approve operator.admin for managed-image byte resolution and require exact-head proof that Control UI preview works while operator.read and unauthenticated callers are denied.

options.title: Permit read-scoped downloads
options.body: Use operator.read consistently with the artifacts.download method contract after confirming that session, artifact, record, and transcript binding adequately protect the local bytes.

options.title: Pause RPC delivery
options.body: Do not expose managed bytes through artifacts.download until a different credential or capability model is designed.

recommendation.title: Keep admin-only bytes
recommendation.body: Approve operator.admin for managed-image byte resolution and require exact-head proof that Control UI preview works while operator.read and unauthenticated callers are denied.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent adjacent Gateway managed-image and HTTP-boundary work makes them the best available routing candidate for this policy choice.
